description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for the internal WebAudioPlayer server component, including factory creation methods, the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal class with its methods, and related data members. It is part of the Rialto media server implementation, handling Web Audio playback via GStreamer and shared memory buffers.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating WebAudioPlayer instances, implementing IWebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
classes.description: Implementation of IWebAudioPlayer and IGstWebAudioPlayerClient, managing Web Audio playback, shared memory, and GStreamer integration.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal with dependencies, configuration, and shared resources.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts audio playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses audio playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to shared memory for playback.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device capabilities such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves current volume level.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a state change.

methods.name: initWebAudioPlayerInternal
methods.description: Initializes the WebAudioPlayer with given parameters.

methods.name: initGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: writeBufferInternal
methods.description: Handles internal buffer writing, to be called on main thread.

methods.name: writeStoredBuffers
methods.description: Flushes stored buffers to GStreamer.

methods.name: updateAvailableBuffer
methods.description: Updates buffer availability after writes.

methods.name: handleWriteDataTimer
methods.description: Handles timer timeout for writing data.

methods.name: getQueuedFramesInShm
methods.description: Returns number of frames queued in shared memory.
